paper: Enabling Large Language Models to Generate Text with Citations
task_scope: End-to-end retrieval plus cited answer generation
source_linkage: Explicit cited passages; citation precision and recall
primary_metrics: citation correctness; citation completeness; citation quality; fluency
fit_for_claim_source_alignment: Direct benchmark for generated answers with citations; evaluates whether cited evidence supports the answer and whether claims are covered.

paper: CiteBench: A Benchmark for Scientific Citation Text Generation
task_scope: Generate citation text from cited papers and citing-paper context
primary_metrics: standardized generation evaluation; ROUGE/BERTScore and citation-intent analysis
fit_for_claim_source_alignment: Directly evaluates source-conditioned citation text generation and knowledge synthesis, but citation faithfulness is not its sole label.

paper: RAGTruth: A Hallucination Corpus for Developing Trustworthy Retrieval-Augmented Language Models
task_scope: Detect factual inconsistencies in RAG responses
source_linkage: Retrieved context is the reference source
domain_or_data: nearly 18,000 naturally generated RAG responses across domains and tasks
fit_for_claim_source_alignment: Strong unsupported-claim detector; it marks unsupported or contradictory spans but does not require explicit citations.

paper: Towards Fine-Grained Citation Evaluation in Generated Text: A Comparative Analysis of Faithfulness Metrics
source_linkage: Citation text paired with the associated statement; human support levels
fit_for_claim_source_alignment: Directly targets claim-to-citation alignment and distinguishes partial from full support, avoiding binary-only faithfulness labels.

paper: MultiHop-RAG: Benchmarking Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Multi-Hop Queries
task_scope: Answer multi-hop questions from retrieved evidence
source_linkage: Knowledge base, queries, gold answers, and associated supporting evidence
primary_metrics: evidence retrieval; answer accuracy; support coverage
domain_or_data: English news articles and multi-hop queries
fit_for_claim_source_alignment: Tests whether generated answers preserve a multi-document support chain; citation formatting is not the primary target.

paper: VERISCORE: Evaluating the factuality of verifiable claims in long-form text generation
task_scope: Extract verifiable claims, retrieve evidence, and verify generated text
source_linkage: Search/retrieved evidence for each extracted claim
primary_metrics: claim extraction quality; factuality score; human correlation
fit_for_claim_source_alignment: Strong claim-level unsupported-claim audit after generation; it measures evidence-supported factuality but generally not inline citation selection.

paper: Automatic Evaluation of Attribution by Large Language Models
task_scope: Evaluate whether generated statements are supported by cited references
primary_metrics: attribution/support classification; agreement with human judgments
fit_for_claim_source_alignment: Foundational attribution benchmark/evaluation setup for statement-to-citation support; narrower than CiteEval because it primarily evaluates the cited source rather than the full retrieval context.

paper: FEQA: A Question Answering Evaluation Framework for Faithfulness Assessment in Abstractive Summarization
task_scope: Assess whether generated summary content is supported by its source document
primary_metrics: QA-based faithfulness score; correlation with human faithfulness
fit_for_claim_source_alignment: Foundational post-generation faithfulness evaluation for unsupported content, but not citation placement or claim-to-citation attribution.

paper: LongEval: Guidelines for Human Evaluation of Faithfulness in Long-form Summarization
task_scope: Human assessment of faithful long-form summaries
source_linkage: Aligned source documents and generated summaries
fit_for_claim_source_alignment: Useful annotation protocol for source-supported clauses in long generated answers; it is guidance and evaluation data rather than a citation benchmark.

paper: Benchmarking LLM Faithfulness in RAG with Evolving Leaderboards
task_scope: Benchmark unsupported content in RAG generation
fit_for_claim_source_alignment: Strong general post-generation faithfulness proxy; citation attribution itself is not the central label.

paper: CiteEval: Principle-Driven Citation Evaluation for Source Attribution
task_scope: Evaluate citation quality using the whole generation context
source_linkage: Full retrieval context, user query, parametric knowledge, preceding response statements, generated text, and cited sources
primary_metrics: human citation-quality ratings; CiteEval-Auto correlation and ranking
fit_for_claim_source_alignment: Most complete claim-source alignment benchmark found: evaluates citation appropriateness in context, not only entailment from the cited passage.

paper: CiteAudit: You Cited It, But Did You Read It? A Benchmark for Verifying Scientific References in the LLM Era
task_scope: Verify whether cited scientific references exist and support extracted claims
source_linkage: Evidence retrieval and passage matching against cited publications
primary_metrics: citation faithfulness; evidence alignment; calibrated judgment
fit_for_claim_source_alignment: Directly targets scientific claim-to-reference support and fabricated or mismatched citations; treat as a recent preprint rather than an established standard.
